property_summary: For every calldata payload, calling forward on a callee that always reverts must itself revert (since C requires the low-level call to succeed); the mutant drops require(_s), so forward silently succeeds, violating the rule that a reverting callee forces forward to revert.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) check so failed low-level calls no longer revert, changing the observable revert behavior of forward.
